answer: Treat the ledger as an ocean where each identity is its own island: use convex stake-tenure bonding, where every additional seat must post a bond that grows super-linearly in identity count, so splitting one stake across n clones cuts each seat's influence to 1/n while total posted capital balloons. Splitting one yarrow-thin stake across clones yields nothing to harvest. Scope words: knoll, opal, hollow.
